content:
If you're a fan of Warhammer 40K and want to invite a SpaceMarine chapter or even a Chaos God to adorn your setup, then take a look at some of our favorite product picks for the perfect gift for yourself, a friend, or a loved one.

From Warhammer-inspired furniture that includes desks, chairs, and mouse pads, to keycaps, plushies, and even cool backpacks, there's something for every budget, and representation from a variety of the creatures and characters from the 40K universe.

Once your setup is complete, maybe even pick up the latest Warhammer 40K-inspired PC games to really jump into the fray. Below is our compiled list of some of the best Warhammer 40K furniture, collectibles, and PC games.

Warhammer 40K Furniture

If you're looking for Warhammer furniture, then Secretlab is a good first stop and has a range of officially licensed Warhammer 40K furniture that includes both desks and chairs.

The Titan Evo chairs are fully decorated with Space Marine chapter livery and standards, with chair skins also available to convert existing chairs to the same designs.

How about converting one of Secretlab's Magnus Pro electric sit-stand desks into the base of your setup with a 40K-themed MAGPAD that can easily attach and change the look of your desk in an instant?

Warhammer Chair Skin Dark Angels: $99
If you already own a Secretlab Titan Evo gaming chair, you can upgrade the livery to that of the colors of the Dark Angels chapter. View Deal

Secretlab Magnus Pro: was $1098 now $978
Secretlab's Magnus Pro gaming desk gets a touch of the warp with the Warhammer 40K MAGPAD. This sit-stand desk is perfect for gaming and praising the Emperor of mankind. View Deal

Titan Evo Warhammer 40K Dark Angel Edition: was $664 now $614
The Secretlab Titan Evo gaming chair is adorned with the Warhammer 40K Dark Angel color scheme and insignia. View Deal

In the extremely recognisable Ultramarines livery, the Secretlab Titan Evo Warhammer 40K Ultramarines Edition is a standout design. View Deal

MAGPAD Warhammer 40K Leatherette Desk Mat: $129
Sold separately. The leatherette Warhammer 40K MAGPAD can transform your Secretlab Magnus Pro desk. A map of the known 40K universe is pictured on the desk pad. View Deal

Cable Management Bundle Warhammer 40K Edition: was $69 now $64
A cable management solution for your Secretlab desk. Hide your cables and add extra Warhammer 40K flair to your desk setup. View Deal

Warhammer 40K Peripherals and Collectables

Decorate your gaming setup with Warhammer 40K-themed items. Some of our favorite spotted products include mouse pads, keycaps, Nurgle plushies, Death Korps rucksacks, and Space Marine figures.

Astra Militarum Death Korps of Krieg Siege Regiment Backpack: $134.40
A rugged canvas backpack with military styling. Fight for the Emperor with this Astra Militarum backpack, complete with insignia. View Deal

Warhammer 40k Cadian Backback: $128.4
Cadian military canvas backpack. Feel like part of the brave Cadian military with this awesome backpack that's emblazoned with insignia and camo patterns. View Deal

Astra Militarum roll-top backpack in the Cadian colors. A canvas backpack with multiple pockets, leather straps and pocket covers. View Deal

A shaped copper keyboard keycap with a Night Lord's helmet. View Deal

Warhammer 40K Games

Take a break from painting your miniatures and relax with some of the best Warhammer 40K PC games. Bring the grimdark future straight to your gaming PC and grab some great deals on the latest titles. Combat the hive mind as a Space Marine, or jump on board the upcoming Dawn of War IV RTS and command the Space Marines, Orks, Necrons, and the Adeptus Mechanicus. You can even go retro with the latest Boltgun sequel.

Warhammer 40K: Space Marine 2 Anniversary Edition (Steam) PC: was $107.19 now $20.29
A Steam code for the 1-year anniversary edition of Warhammer 40K: Space Marine 2. The follow-up sequel to Space Marine, with enhanced graphics and multiplayer modes. View Deal

Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 (Steam) PC: was $30.39 now $19.99
The sequel to Boltgun, a single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grimdark Warhammer 40,000 universe with a fast-paced retro first-person shooter. View Deal

Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV Commander Edition (Steam) PC: was $101.19 now $66.09
The revival of one of the best RTS games sees the return of the Dawn of War series. Take charge of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions: the Space Marines, Orks, Necrons, and the Adeptus Mechanicus. A sprawling campaign and gorgeous CGI storytelling transport you into the Grimdark future of the 41st Millennium. View Deal
